[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!PDWI!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fc9549b7e-f1e2-4109-85a8-b0d1e21147bd_840x756.webp]]

For our next date she came to my show in LA, where I used her as a prop, to show other girls how cool I am:

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!X-Sl!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fd243e7a4-4334-486a-a56f-2818f95c7656_704x1132.png]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!c8rC!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Ffd744a95-91af-40c4-9b14-b7407dd8e76b_716x442.png]]

Around this time I was directionless.

After my show I was recruited by the producer of a conservative men’s magazine based in LA. They wanted me to write for them, for money. Oh, so like a job. Okay. They wanted me to do “gonzo journalism,” which I was excited to do, because I thought it might influence me to break out of my routine.

My first assignment was to attend an “IRL Dating Event” and report on the experience.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!EmEl!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F8aa82839-a6c7-497e-82fd-712fbd14bcd8_1562x1394.png]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!aAYW!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fda98249b-110d-44ef-8a2e-0c61e11a16ec_794x1394.png]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!D5dy!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fae6889bc-24ff-485f-811f-f965fabf3228_786x868.png]]

I did the thing. Before doing the thing I took a hotel room at the Sheraton, by the airport, in case I Got Laid. I also took Molly, to make it more enjoyable for myself.

The article lives here. I can’t post it on Substack because if I do that then the guys who paid me $500 for it will kill me.

Long story short I ended up in the hotel room with Annabelle instead. Fucking her on-molly.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!3O5I!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Ffbf5ea97-2acd-48dd-bf2a-490a528b589b_768x1024.jpeg]]

That next morning is when I finally grew the balls to start asking for money.

She said do we have to check out at 11?

I said if you want another night, buy it for me. She said OK.

The next morning we had a similar conversation. Except this time she said Why don’t I just get us a room for a week. At a “cuter” hotel. We can take pictures for my OnlyFans.

I said Okay, if you insist!

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!P2aF!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F5d0f2e35-277f-4e84-94b9-8b77fbda0b72_1146x1392.png]]

Later that day, driving the van to the beach, I heard an advertisement on the radio. It mentioned that Larry David was in town, for the “Netflix is a Joke” Comedy festival. Shane Gillis, Louis CK, wow…

All at once I realized how I would spend the next week in LA. I’d go see a different live stand up show every day of the week, and write about all of them, and sell that article to the Magazine, and call it “Fear and Laughing in Los Angeles.”

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!rioB!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F0db9726d-68c3-4866-99d3-22e24b884069_768x1024.jpeg]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!22fG!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fa88d6f65-9a25-42eb-9030-61bdb2077e1f_710x1124.png]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!lw2z!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F3204877e-6595-44f7-bb38-ceca3af302e5_718x1120.png]]

I’m not evil. I wanted to make the experience productive for her too, if possible. Maybe even profitable. So I became her photographer:

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!igAJ!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F8c713543-9a47-4430-964a-d16f60808443_768x1024.jpeg]]

And then the world was buying me tickets to a stand up show, every day of the next week.

I wrote about and posted about each one:

Monday: Shane Gillis

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!Z4Sk!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Ffd485a2b-5f6b-496b-8989-4bdd8879fce2_1179x1856.jpeg]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!M4VG!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F4c45a124-49b4-45cf-9640-7bb7ca9cd12d_1179x1571.jpeg]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!CC4s!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F4d6656d2-4065-4ca3-9893-3e7f48586b00_1179x1751.jpeg]]

Thursday - Dave Chappelle

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!0wSv!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F3b989871-ee6b-40ef-9117-c0a482a6d2ca_1179x1409.jpeg]]

Friday - John Mulaney

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!s0zN!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F26c87cac-a800-4825-a947-6f3ece2dc000_1179x1738.jpeg]]

Saturday - Adam Friedland

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!vSfQ!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F23b57e02-a84e-495f-9587-5c892c5fdac3_1179x1861.jpeg]]

I was trying to write something unique, and funny, and true, that could go viral, every day of the week, while also trying to get laid, and please Annabelle, and the Magazine, make people feel like their investment in me was well-spent…

After Adam Friedland I broke down:

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!wxe1!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F9f267676-b4d7-492b-8666-189c8ff28356_720x1228.png]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!vsSN!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F91db1438-e935-4022-86e2-574f5bdf0b8d_714x1228.png]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!NImD!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F662467fa-f54e-4254-97ad-dd9cd72181b3_724x1034.png]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!aU7q!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fabc3e863-0204-4737-a46b-a24476ae0aa9_720x616.png]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!kgfP!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F830ff715-91b2-4a5c-b210-bdbf0445d5bd_543x319.png]]

On my last day in LA we got brunch. She had several mimosas because she’s an alcoholic. I said I needed to leave the city, I was feeling overwhelmed socially and needed to start driving East. She said she didn’t want me to leave. She didn’t want to go back to her normal life. She can’t stand her roommates and she likes being with me, even if she has to pay for everything. I said if you really mean that then join me in the van. Run away with me. Live with me in the van as we drive across the country. She was unsure. “But I have a lease, and my roommates will hate me…”

I said Okay that’s fine, and dropped her off at her place and said goodbye.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!1YrN!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fe04a54cd-c575-401e-8539-fcbc39f28ddf_1158x1104.png]]

I drove alone to Big Bear, a couple hours East. I rented a cabin for a really cheap price, like $40 a night, because it was the “off season” in May.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!Og56!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fdf34e2ca-9bc2-49c5-8eef-ae85376359fd_1128x1274.png]]

A few days later she called me. She said my Mom wants to go to Vegas. This next weekend. Do you want to meet in Vegas and go from there? I can take all my bags.

I said yes, that would be good, let’s meet in Vegas. And go from there.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!xpsj!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F5432f0b4-a2c0-4601-b657-b3955569e0e8_1154x1358.png]]

I’m sure her mother will love me

memoirs.title: You Look Good for 67
memoirs.full_text:
[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!qHiY!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fa7f202b2-2137-4dc8-974b-d7df0201b2f7_712x936.png]]

I hit a nigger with my van yesterday. Not on purpose. I was on a call with my little sister, in my noise canceling headphones. We were talking about her future. I was trying to convince her to take the first step towards entrepreneurship so that she can eventually break free from the shackles of employment.

I was in a tight parking lot. I rolled in looking for parking but there were no spots. The escape route was blocked off ahead for some hispanic popsicle stand, so I had to back up and turn out of the lot with very little space.

I was still on the phone with Sunny. I don’t know how the fuck this happened but I bumped into the rear end of this white sedan, hard enough to leave a gaping punctured hole in the frame. My first instinct was to just drive away pretending it didn’t happen, because the hit probably wasn’t that bad, and I have no insurance, and I’ve been living an extremely precarious life over the past year, and so rather than deal with the cops or give anybody my contact info I thought I’d just flee the scene. But unlike the last time I hit somebody with my van, I was not on the highway, I was in a tight busy parking lot on a Sunday afternoon. And the guy I hit was right there in his parked car when it happened. And worst of all, he was a real nigga.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!9M2w!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fa17b8351-69fc-46c3-bbaf-615b9870cc72_1788x1920.webp]]

Once I realized there was no escape I calmly rolled my window down. And there he is: a 6’2+ big ass black guy with a tough wrinkled face wearing a tight white gym shirt with the sleeves ripped off. I think he was wearing a white sweatband too. He greets me like a junkyard dog: YO, WHAT THE FUCK! WHAT THE FUCK MAN GET OUT THE CAR! YOU HIT MY FUCKIN’ CAR! FUCK, NIGGA, FUCK!

I’m screaming Fuck too. More-so once I get out to see the pierced hole in his rear bumper. There’s a more standard scratch too, and for the first minute or so of our screaming I can’t believe my metal tow-hitch actually caused the hole. I recollected those stories I read online about how African Americans jump in front of cars and collect insurance claims. I denied: THERE’S NO WAY MY VAN DID THAT, THE HEIGHTS DON’T ALIGN—

“SHUT THE FUCK UP NIGGA YOU THINK I’M LYIN? THAT SHIT WAS NOT THERE YOU HIT MY FUCKIN CAR MAN!” Yes Yes I hit your fuckin car but I didn’t do THAT… it was too ugly. It looked like an extremely expensive repair and I can’t deal with this shit right now… I’m almost out of crypto.

He could tell I’m not the type to pay for things like this, because my Chevy Astro is a real old piece of shit. So he wouldn’t let me leave. I said all right, I have insurance (lie) I guess we exchange contact info and—FUCK THAT NIGGA FUCK THAT SHIT YOU’RE PAYING FOR THIS YOU HIT MY CAR MAN! FUCK YOU! I’LL BEAT YOUR ASS RIGHT NOW, FUCK YOU TALKIN BOUT CONTACT INFO—

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!jQTP!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F626ba8f3-75b2-4fc3-bf02-2c4d7e948a05_1017x606.png]]

The security officer on duty in that parking lot was shaped like a human gumball. He was fluffy. He was Ernie from the George Lopez sitcom. He tried to mediate the situation but he was dealing with two niggas well past his paygrade. I’m sure the surrounding shoppers were watching too, my van in that screwed-up position was blocking anybody from getting out.

Ernie was telling Mr. T you need to let him go, that van’s blocking traffic. Mr T. was yelling FUCK THAT MAN! FUCK THAT SHIT, HE’S NOT GOING ANYWHERE! CALL THE PO-LICE WE’RE SORTING THIS SHIT OUT NOW —

He looked ready to beat the shit out of me. He was surely twice my weight. I look like Marty Supreme now. I’m sober but I took Molly last night and the adrenaline makes me sharp.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!dS8X!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F8348720a-34f3-40b7-ae61-fa38c34b1943_684x514.png]]

JUST TAKE MY CONTACT INFO SO I CAN GO, THAT’S HOW THIS WORKS. YOU’RE NOT A COP YOU CAN’T DETAIN ME —

FUCK THAT SHIT YOU AIN’T LEAVIN! We’re both appealing to the totally useless security guy. I’m trying to walk/climb back into the drivers seat of the van I live in and he’s blocking me pushing me off.

NO. NIGGA NO—

He’s distracted for a moment by onlookers and so I creep around the side to sneak in through the passenger side door. I can’t get my fingers to the lock button up front before he yanks the drivers’ door open to stop me.

FUCK YOU THINK YOU’RE DOING? I’LL BEAT YOUR ASS — SOMEBODY CALL THE PO-LICE …

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!Btu_!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F50477da7-9039-4453-aa72-74292703c1ff_446x264.png]]

I’m trapped. I’m holding my phone tight in one hand with my key between my knuckles in the other. I haven’t had a moment to end the call with my sister. I’m screaming at fat fucking Ernie: “HEY CAN YOU DO YOUR JOB MAN? THIS GUY’S GONNA BEAT THE SHIT OUT OF ME!” I’m yelling just as loud as the nig. I need to get out of here before the cops show. I have a lot more on me than this little fender and I have a strong suspicion I won’t be driving away from that interaction alone.

Ernie has no idea. He turns to the gorilla: “Technically sir you’re supposed to exchange contact, file a police report, and let him leave.”

Mr. T doesn’t give a fuck. He knows me, he’s seen me before, in another life, he knows he’s never getting that payout. He’s performing a Citizens’ Arrest. He won’t take my contact and he won’t let me back into my van, I don’t know what to do.

I’LL KNOCK YOU THE FUCK OUT BRO!

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!75cl!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fe1b40552-6f75-4a0b-8807-adeb045e6b96_640x480.jpeg]]

Some part of me wants him to swing. I’ve never been hit in my life. Now there’s a better-dressed black guy who’s blocked by my van saying: “Can you at least let him move so I can get out.” Mr. T says HELL NO! I try to weasel past him into the drivers seat again. Big Nigga puts his hands on me at last. Throws me out a few feet back but I’m still standing. “BEAT THE SHIT OUT OF ME! DO IT!” I’m looking right at him for some reason. I’m gesturing to all the people watching and the cameras that must be hanging above. “YOU’LL GO TO JAIL NOT ME!” The security guy mentions the word “assault” at one point. Everyone’s turning on Mr. T now, I’m not legally obligated to be here any more and they want to get on with their day.

The police have been called and are on their way. memoirs.title: The End of Worst Boyfriend Ever
memoirs.full_text:
I broke up with my girlfriend last week.

She asked if we were renewing our lease and I said “actually no, sorry, i’m getting a van and driving away”

And that is exactly what I did.

I couldn’t explain anything to her, with the cheating, and the prostitutes, and the blog, because where would I even begin.

I sold all my things, even my car, on Facebook Marketplace, over the course of one huge week.

She cried herself to sleep every night until I left.

I bought a 2005 Chevy Astro for $4,000 and it works perfectly, it hasn’t given me a single problem. But it could, and I would be fucked.

Because now I live in it. I sleep in parking lots, I shit at Planet Fitness, I eat McDonalds every night. Last night I got 10 nuggets for $1, on the app.

It has been the best week of my life. I am finally free.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!fMnf!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F81967196-6444-4b55-bdc1-7149339e6b41_600x450.jpeg]]

Also I quit my job. My boss called me into his office after I was “late” for the 1000th time and I said erm Actually no, I quit. And no I don’t have another offer lined up. I bought a van and I’m just going to drive away.

I’ll make money doing odd jobs on craigslist and also my DOGECOIN is rapidly increasing in value so I’ll be okay for a while.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!E4yN!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fd51d607b-b1ec-4cac-be06-585f7ed8cc60_1428x1140.png]]

thank you Trump-san for dodging that bullet

I told this to anyone who asked, including my parents, and they all, more or less, cheered me on.

They said “I’ve seen Van Life on YouTube, that’s awesome man! Good for you!”

But I don’t know what the fuck that is, I’m just running away, I hate my life and I hate making my girlfriend feel so ugly because of the person I am and Seattle gets depressingly dark and cold in the winter and so I’m just driving South, down the west coast, chasing the sun.

I need Adderall to produce all these words, but I knew I would lose my health insurance when I quit my job, so I told my psychiatrist I was going on a “long vacation” in December, asking for 2 months supply upfront, which he granted. He will never hear from me again.

I have friends up and down the west coast because I’m a professional people pleaser sociopath and so when I get to their city they love to see me. And sometimes I even like to see them too.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!w3bi!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F317b5ac0-faf3-41ab-9985-18b1bcf6f2fb_500x341.gif]]

Mostly though, I’m just writing, and running, and fucking, once in the van actually, because I’m single again, and after all, there’s nothing better than fresh love.

I don’t know what will become of this blog, it used to be my escape, where I could hide from my life, but now I have nothing left from which to hide.

The stories have all been completely literally true, it’s not a bit, I wish it was, but the only way I ever get anywhere interesting is by recording life as it is.

The End

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!CQNF!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fb350964c-735d-4977-95d6-ff26507d164d_500x378.gif]]

April 7th, 2025
Edison, NJ

A police man woke me up last night, knocking on the van, shining a light inside. I was parked in a quiet dark lot outside the University football stadium. I almost didn’t open up but then I did.

He said SIR PLEASE OPEN UP THE WINDOW SO WE CAN TALK and I said alright alright… yeah just let me put some pants on… yes i’m a homeless freak i know...

I opened up and He said “Wow.”

I start all these interactions the same way: all right i’ll move. i know, not supposed to be here, yes sir, okay,

And I listen to their whole spiel about “trespassing” and “this is university property” and blah blah blah, yeah I know Mario I gotta move, I will start the van and drive to a different place.

He questions me about my life, & where i’m going, half out of Officer-ly-duty and half, I suspect, out of genuine curiosity: what is this mid 20s white guy doing sleeping in this van with a bed in it in this University parking lot on a Sunday night here in New Jersey?

“Are you a student?”

no…

“Well what are you doing here?”

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!Kmeo!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Ffcdaab66-f9b9-4d23-b62e-f4cca646516f_220x166.gif]]

um… well to be honest officer i’m here to fuck a 20 year old girl

I didn’t say all this to him, but here’s the truth:

I’m on a journey around the US in this van, I write a blog about it, I’m publishing a book too, but I am here in [redacted], New Jersey specifically because there is a really hot Virgin Asian Girl with a real penchant for the literary stylings of the Worst Boyfriend Ever, and we’ve been talking since February, back when I was in Texas, and now I’m all the way here in April and I’m finally about to meet her.

These pigs always get a little uncomfortable at the sight of me, the inside of my van looks like a really small bedroom, they can feel that they’re intruding on my personal space by opening up, I’m just an innocent-looking white boy, present and calm, it’s funny to see them make sense of the situation.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!aYMe!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fe6e3af98-4e4b-4abb-ba91-8f10644c5b98_1386x1064.png]]

He actually took my drivers license, which I really didn’t want to give, because for the past 5,000 miles I’ve had a strong inkling that there is a warrant out for my arrest.

For the past 6 months I’ve been racking up parking tickets in all 50 states, I just let them fly off my windshield, I go through every toll bridge without paying, every express lane, I thought there’s got to be a whole litany of legal fees associated with this big blue van here, which are then associated with my drivers license via government tracking internet technology… but nope, apparently not today. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

He walky-talkied a check on the license like I was some kind of criminal and it came back clean. okay great… I was half-expecting to get arrested right there. That greasy Italian retard had no idea who he was dealing with.

He said alright you’re good, you just have to leave the premises because this is University property,

I was like yup yup sure, I know, I was hella sleepy but nothing wakes me up faster than The Law,

He said if I catch you parking overnight on University premises again it won’t be the same, I look at him saying yes yes i understand please just let me drive away i’m fucking tired and I hate new jersey….

I really do hate new jersey. they drive like assholes here. i got cut off by a school bus this morning... Amy you go to college in a ghetto. I see why you want to transfer.

memoirs.title: My Racist Sexist Van Life: 3 Month Update
memoirs.full_text:
[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!OMYZ!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fb975784e-e634-48ca-9396-2bc93c559de1_474x265.jpeg]]

We interrupt this racist sexist clown show to give a 3-month update on Van Life, reporting live from Quartzsite Arizona.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!e3px!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F5ff5049f-2f2f-4bea-a2c1-ed85b1729e92_1098x1168.jpeg]]

I live in a 2005 Chevy Astro van. I have no sink, no toilet, nothing…

I have a $20 Planet Fitness Membership which is where I shower every night, no matter where I am, because there’s a Planet Fitness in every city in the USA. Those parking lots are filled with van lifers for this reason. I never talk to any of them.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!dtsj!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F9d8ee379-c370-485e-86ff-b08dec9e3336_1030x1066.png]]

the roof racks make people think i’m a real person with a “job.” #stealth

Where do you park overnight?

Anywhere. Nobody gives a shit. Ever.

In the few times they have, I just say SORRY!!! and move my van elsewhere, because it has wheels.

Usually I sleep in suburbs. I play it by ear…

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!NGt4!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F50fdafe5-7b2c-4c53-9501-6044b5eae4b9_994x608.webp]]

Really I just go to places where black people aren’t. Places where the ground is flat, so I’m not slipping off the bed in the middle of the night. Places where it’s quiet, and dark.

Nobody ever cares. I get some of the best sleep of my life.

There was one time in Oregon I got “the knock” by some public security officers. I was in a Rec Center parking lot, watching a movie.

They said “open up!” and so I did, and they said “woah dude… sick setup.”

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!UEc4!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F410a9e24-588a-4567-bc39-7cb24d7b701a_2000x1500.jpeg]]

one girl called these the “fuckboy lights.” shut the fuck up you stupid bitch

How do you heat yourself? Isn’t it cold?

Yes, especially up north, at first. So I got an electric blanket for $25 at a convenience store, that plugs into my big portable Bluetti battery, and that is all the heating I ever use, in my sleeping bag, at night.

I also have a propane heater, but I don’t use it much, because the Co2 makes me woozy and I can’t fall asleep with it on or I’ll die of monoxide poisoning. The electric blanket is almost always enough.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!WX-C!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F7ac7712d-6218-4ebb-9c4e-9f3be2c7f5c1_1042x1164.png]]

this thing scares all the hoes. it looks like a bomb

I charge my Bluetti while I’m driving, or at Planet Fitness, or at coffee shops while I work. That’s where I spend the vast majority of my time— coffee shops.

What do you do all day?

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!X3tT!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fb8502d40-7124-431b-85db-7718db9791a4_4032x3024.jpeg]]

i set up camp. i lock in

Here’s a typical Van Life day for me:

Wake up in the van. Pop an Adderall. Roll out of bed and find a place in the world to take a piss. I just piss everywhere, on everything, like Calvin and Hobbes.

Google “coffee shop near me.” Find one that looks like it has:

comfortable seating

outlets

*bonus points if it’s near a college, so I can be happily tormented by passing females all day long

Go to coffee shop. Buy $5 latte. Ask for bathroom code (in low-trust areas like LA) and the wifi password. Wash face in sink. Take a mirror selfie.

Fall into a deep trance where I write as much as I can before my lizard brain compels me to open Google Chrome and start gooning to the Rest of The Internet… With any luck I tire of this and get back to work writing these stories or finding new girls victims for inspiration.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!c7PI!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F7f282a38-9617-4eba-a32c-3d81d45c9048_1042x1203.png]]

please don’t tempt me izzy

This goes on all day, sometimes I get so lost in this process I’m hunched over staring at a screen from 7AM to 4 PM— the only thing that compels me outside is the fact that it’s getting dark, and I need to see the sun.

Then I google “running trail near me,” find a nice spot, go for a run. If weather permits.

Drive to “planet fitness near me” and lift weights if I’m feeling particularly bad about myself that day, get naked in front of a bunch of other dudes, usually mexicans because it’s Planet Fitness, take a shower,

get dinner, get back in the van zip up the sleeping bag and go to sleep. Slight variations for side quests. There are no weekends. I never know what day it is. It doesn’t matter.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!TLn3!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F4356ddb4-ff06-409f-890c-8b74f5e567e7_1280x720.jpeg]]

if you look like this and live in The South, DM me immediately. It has been 23 days since I’ve felt the touch of a woman. I’m going to kill myself

Don’t you get lonely?

NO!

But… how do you fuck?

With little regard for the consequences. Life is short man.

I’ll just be straightforwardly autistic about it: I have fucked 5 girls since becoming homeless in October. 3 of them were readers. 2 of them were in the van. 1 of them nourished my soul. She has since blocked me. Fuck my life.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!zS_m!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fcb3ff0d2-18d9-44d8-ba37-08d43daf2442_1702x1276.webp]]

my curtains are much worse than this but they get the job done

I don’t prefer to fuck in the van… it’s more of a last resort. We just drive to a relatively remote location and put the blinds up.

How do you choose where to go next?

Vibes. I choose the next city based mostly on Vibes.

So far I’ve let the winds of change (side quests, females, craigslist) take me from place to place, as long as it’s all in the same general direction— South from Seattle to LA, East across the country, and so on. I want to do a great big circle.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!FrCi!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fed6f969b-b46b-4f47-b9e6-8eba20a31c92_1524x944.png]]

my progress as of mid January. a great big L

But where do you shit?

In a coffee shop. Every single morning. Once and then never again. I thought this would be a problem but I’m perfectly regular so it literally has never once been.

Caffeine is my friend. I am willfully addicted to coffee. I drink exactly 1 cup every day. Your mileage may vary.

Where do you do laundry?

Anywhere. Friends’ apartments, girls apartments, laundromats. Every 2-3 weeks.

Somehow the laundry does not stink up the van. I keep it in one of those big blue IKEA bags. The fact that I can never hang my clothes means that I have to use dryers and shrink everything, which sucks, but hey—sometimes you gotta sacrifice.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!WeAp!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F37dab476-cd01-45c6-82d9-ff4a3b32a861_723x629.jpeg]]

The Swedes make good stuff

What do you eat?

Food is my #1 expense, because I don’t have the technology to do any real cooking in here (my 500W battery isn’t strong enough to power a cooktop or electric stove, you gotta shell out thousands for those big boys),

Cooking is not worth the time/effort for me right now. I’m no off-grid survivalist guy, I just go to Starbucks and get a coffee and a sandwich and then when it gets dark I get a couple slices of pizza or a burger and I call it a night. Yeah I know, seed oils.

I don’t need a ton of food, I’m 150 lbs, Mr. Skeleton Man feels just fine don’t worry, I got peanut butter sandwiches for when I’m in a pinch, I got some fruit in a cooler, I’m still kind of figuring this out but I don’t do anything special for food.

My number 1 dinner meal is a Double Quarter Pounder with cheese for $4 from McDonalds (app). 800 calories, good protein, tasty, I like it. I feel like Donald Trump.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!qwrv!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fd07a45d5-fc20-42a5-88fd-da1e72a5d87d_1597x1600.jpeg]]

Are you happy?

Yes. I’m happy as I’ve ever been. I love being alone.

If I’m ever lonely I’ve got the whole entire internet, every movie ever made, I’ve got Hinge, I’ve got “bars near me,” but honestly that feeling rarely ever comes because I’m so enamored with the work— whenever I feel lost/don’t know what to do I just write that down and the problem solves itself.

How long will you do this for?

Until I have a reason to stop. Until I get bored of it.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!cNYG!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fe0588417-4a48-49a3-9652-40739a0421ec_762x769.jpeg]]

Until this ’05 Chevy Astro with 175k miles on it breaks down and it’s prohibitively expensive to get it back on the road.

^ That day hasn’t come yet but I know it will. Sometimes it barely starts and it scares me, but then it goes several weeks starting perfect every time. I just get oil changes and pray.

I have no desire to return to normal life. I was so bored living in the same place doing the same thing with the same people fucking the same girl looking out the same window at the same view going to the same job dealing with the same bullshit every single same fucking day..

I fear I’ll never go back, I’ll just be a wandering Peter Pan Man-child out on the road forever. I don’t think much about Forever though. I’ve still got a lot of America to go through, I’ve barely even started.

I want to do a full circle around the US. Seattle, SoCal, Miami, NYC, Chicago, back to Seattle. If I don’t have a book’s worth of stories by then I may as well just kill myself.

How Do You Make Money?

I don’t. I live on Dogecoin and a dream. I find gigs on craigslist. One time I massaged this guy at his Gay Ranch. I make a little on Substack. Thanks if you paid sub by the way. I hope to make money on a book. I only need about $20k per year to maintain my wonderful homeless life.

Are the stories real?

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!jHK_!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fec3247af-d125-4222-92ab-2587f267fb00_489x380.png]]

DM Me if you’re going to Mardis Gras. Next week. In New Orleans. I need to see some titties.

In January I had perhaps the most destructive and expensive month of my life.

I did a bad thing and got caught. I feel terrible. Mostly because I got caught.

So I moved into this extremely nice apartment today. 22nd floor huge studio on Wall Street. Modern. All white everything. Looks better than the photos. I’ve stayed in maybe 30, 40 different places in the past year or so of traveling, this is the best one.

The apartment key he gave me didn’t work. It is the right key, but it takes significant finagling. This morning I got it in 60 seconds, but now it’s taking 10 minutes and I’m so frustrated…

So I text the owner of this apartment, do you have any tips for getting in? He says turn and pull, yeah I’ve been doing that, he just video calls me.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!C2i5!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F4003cc29-244d-4c96-aa85-6347f89f7d36_656x678.png]]

Are you wearing my jacket?

For my mental health.

October 11th, 2026

I did. Book a one way flight back home. Get in my van, and go for a drive.

I drove down from Seattle to Los Angeles, and then up to Vegas, through Salt Lake City, took a detour to Tokyo, almost didn’t make it home, flew back and drove on to Denver, crashed with my Mom, drove on to Chicago, tried a meditation retreat but dropped out halfway through, tried injecting Testosterone, took another detour to Los Angeles to prostitute myself and write a screenplay, drove on through Indiana, Ohio, Pennsylvania, and now I’m back in New York City again.

I’ve been sitting on this post for 8 months now, because I forgot. That the blog and me are not the same thing.

Last week I posted the “rape” part of this on Twitter, out of context, because I felt I had a funny punchline for it, it was topical, and it’s good writing.

Within a couple days all these people with huge audiences were publicly calling for my arrest.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!52aX!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F8b3c8110-8fd3-4783-b51b-7258d7e06568_679x672.jpeg]]

More people came out to say that my Writing Sucks… which honestly hurt more. I am truly a Sensitive Young Man after all.

But..

Fortunately, though, my product is good, and so all this outrage just prompted more people to find my work, and send me money, to keep the words coming, to keep me alive.

I am going to try to live in New York again. Or at least establish some kind of permanent residence. I’ve been non-stop traveling for so long, 2 years now, and this feels like a fertile place to stop.

Maybe less cocaine this time.

memoirs.title: My Japanese Sugar Mama
memoirs.full_text:
The reason I’m in Japan is that this girl from San Francisco found my blog (thanks Drunk Wisconsin), developed a “hyperfixation” on me, sent me money, and asked if I wanted to meet up with her in Tokyo later this month. Of course I said yes.

She hadn’t told me much about herself, besides the fact that she draws lewd art, and that she works in tech/finance, and that she’s 30 years old. Her English was not great, as far as I could read over text, but she seemed sweet, and she seemed to be on my side, and most importantly, she seemed to be comfortable buying me shit.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!4ZNa!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fbb09464f-63cd-48ac-b264-0131a27581a4_1170x1015.jpeg]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!pYiL!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fd5b7da71-54c2-4152-a9df-aa3dfb179e19_800x567.webp]]

and she drew me some wonderful pictures

She first sent me $999, which is my founding subscription price on Substack, completely arbitrary, and then she sent me $400, to buy a flight to Japan, and then once I chickened out of buying it she just went ahead and bought me one herself. For December 15th-24. Great. Gave me something to look forward to. I was starting to get sick of the Philippines, figuratively and literally.

I had just endured a hellish last week in that shithole country. I was in Siargao, a quieter island where I meant to go to unwind, decompress, heal, so that I could show up in Japan feeling healthy, looking attractive, being totally off-Adderall so that i could woo this Asian girl from SF with a lot of money while she would chaperone me around Japan, paying for everything. She even mentioned taking me to brothels. Which, I know, sounds unbelievable, but there are some really unique strange autistic people in this world, and they all love my blog, and so to me anything’s possible.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!aHaJ!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F956adcf1-5d70-478d-91da-1143eef76c21_642x574.png]]

Siargao was a bust: I got food poisoning, and sun poisoning, or some other kind of poisoning i barely know with about 5 days to go until my trip. endless diarrhea. maximum dehydration. chills. headache, fever, lightheaded, everything. could not go outside. constant nightmare. and i was still in the Philippines where it’s humid and 90 degrees year round, and i was running out of money, like down to my last few hundred… nightmare nightmare nightmare. slogged my way out of siargao on a tiny flight to cebu then another tiny flight to manila, carrying heavy bags, still so sick, everything was horrible, got into my last bnb in manila, realized i was carrying a shitton of adderall and i probably shouldn’t take all this into japan, freaked out about that but decided after much deliberation and redditing that i should do it anyway, left most of my drugs with some girl in Manila but made sure to pack a few pills in my carry-on just in case.

Had to get to japan, had to get to japan, had to get to japan…

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!mXyv!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F2062b16b-ac1f-4378-a519-607aa435a2a4_1188x1214.png]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!UaWz!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F67f8962e-d337-4c46-9dbc-c13c19aa8e4c_690x426.png]]

Landed at the airport. Immediately in immigrations line I’m in love with this place: it’s so fucking quiet. No jabbering, everyone is clean straight-faced and respectful. Japanese girls looking at me, even in my sickly disheveled state, with a little bit of interest and it gives me hope.

I know I’m going to need to see Ana, my Japanese Sugar Mama, immediately or I’m going to be super lost with two heavy bags. Japan is not as English-friendly as the Philippines. And they’re not bending over backwards to help foreigners. I’ve heard several times they actually tire of foreigners and don’t allow them into many establishments. So many rules here, I just know I’m going to be fucking up everything I do, so I’m hopeful/confident Ana will show up to pick me up and chauffeur me around as soon as I’m past immigration.

Wait in the long line. Fill out entry card. They scan my face. I’ve got Schedule 1 Narcotics in my bag. No dogs to sniff them out. No more bag checks. Everything is Daijoubou, I get past security easily and upstairs to the meat of this terminal. Luckily for me it’s open 24 hours a day.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!KkqA!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fad4a5f9f-95ea-4db2-b330-ec511b351655_1399x1672.jpeg]]

Message Ana on Substack. Okay WYA? Okay you coming? Hello? Ana? It’s like 4 PM now. I sit down and have some ramen. It’s too spicy. See a good mix of foreigners and Japanese at this airport. Don’t talk to a single soul, I am completely alone with my laptop and clothes and not much else.

Also I have no money. I am down to $70 USD.

Which I thought would be fine, because Ana was going to be my sugar mama, remember.

This is not fine because she is MIA. She arrived before me. What the fuck is going on. 5 hours later it’s 9 PM. Still no response. I think she must have just arrived, got tired, and fallen asleep. Blood boiling. Seeing hot Japanese girls at the airport wearing very short skirts. Dick tortured. Where is Ana. Will she be hot. We never exchanged pictures. God what if she’s ghosting me… I’m so fucked.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!pFJw!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fd7e94b49-691e-4b4d-8c94-1abbd62b78ed_300x204.jpeg]]

11 PM. I’ve made several trips to these little food marts and everything I buy is delicious. But the last of my funds are slowly trickling away… I’m going into panic mode. I really don’t want to ask my readers for money but I don’t know what else to do. I put too many eggs in this Ana basket. We’ve been texting for weeks… I can’t believe she’s not responding.

Midnight now. Finally she responds. Holy shit. She says “I will get you when I’m ready” WTF? I’ve been sitting here for 9 hours… her English gets worse and worse.

She says ask someone how to take train to Nippori Station. I say I would really prefer if you came to get me… she just sucks so much at texting now, I can’t believe it. I don’t know what has changed from before Japan to now but I am feeling so alone. And I’m still sick, extremely tired, holding two heavy bags.. I curse God knowing I deserve to be this situation for the kind of life i’ve lived.

So the train’s closed for the night and she’s responding poorly every 70 minutes or so and at 1 AM I just say fuck it and find a place to sleep. controls.title: How to defend an exploding AI attack surface when the attackers haven't shown up (yet)
controls.full_text:
[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!gt8X!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fbf53439a-f190-464e-bddd-1007f2a2e088_1024x559.png]]

The dilemma in AI agent security in 2026 is that organizational attack surface is expanding at comic pace but, at least as of January, the attackers haven’t yet shown up (at least at the level of serious attackers achieving serious objectives a la ransomware or nation state level compromise of a network via AI native risk vectors like prompt injection), which means we lack empirical signals to tune / train defenses, and help prioritize where leaders should pay the price in friction and resources to reduce security risk.

Again, even if we see some petty / script kiddie level attacks jailbreaking models, or some examples of attackers executing traditional kill chains with help from AI, real ransomware criminals and nation-states don’t commonly use prompt injections and model poisoning -- attacks on models themselves -- to achieve real goals (yet).

We also lack catastrophic, unambiguous horror stories where AI coding tools have quietly injected zero click exploitable vulnerabilities into scaled production codebases (yet).

The result is a tension between a discourse where attacks are identified via red teaming and the reality that we have little knowledge of which attacks will be practical for and actually exploited by real attackers. Meanwhile organizational leaders often feel we shouldn't let speculative-sounding security concerns slow down AI adoption.

This presents a kind of AI security risk overhang; an exponentially growing attack surface is not being attacked yet, leaving security folks in a tough spot within our organizations and with respect to how we prioritize burning down this growing mass of poorly understood risk.

Imagine having to set up strategic defenses for a magic, porous fortress whose surface area keeps expanding when you haven’t met or seen the enemy yet and the king keeps wondering why the defenses are so costly and whether enemy is a very big deal.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!vQWU!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fc4dfbb0a-3f78-4230-80b6-7c0c19c7fa76_1830x990.png]]

Dialable controls as the thing to build as fast as possible now

We should build dialable controls that are lightweight and low friction now but which can be easily dialed to be more severe, and higher-friction, as risks materialize, and as a function of how they materialize.

Here are some examples of what I mean:

Dialable deterministic controls

Imagine a highly configurable sandbox for a coding agent. At low settings, users can skip permissions more freely because the sandbox makes that choice safer by default. At high settings, you get hard boundaries around sensitive operations, explicit restrictions on destructive actions, and non-negotiable ingress and egress constraints. The point is not that one mode is universally correct. The point is that the sandbox supports both without reimplementation, and lets leaders tighten it as real attacks on AI agents materialize.

Dialable alignment controls

It is fashionable to dismiss prompt injection classifiers, input validation, and fine-tuning as trivially bypassable. But given market realities, many applications will ship with only this layer for a while. In the messy middle of real usage, where most abuse is not performed by expert red teams running maximally adaptive attacks, these controls are meaningfully better than nothing.

More importantly, they are inherently dialable. We can tighten thresholds, tune sensitivity, escalate guardrail strictness, and adjust policies as threat intelligence improves, rather than treating “guardrails” as a single, brittle bet.

Dialable detection and response

Detection and response imposes cost on AI automation and AI UX while giving you the telemetry to detect patterns, measure the frequency of risky behavior, and make escalation decisions based on data rather than vibes. It is dialable; you can turn it up by increasing investigation staffing, loosening alert thresholds (accepting lower precision to buy higher recall), and evolving monitoring rules as you learn where AI native attacks are used in real killchains.

Medium term, we need a risk heatmap grounded in observed attacker behavior across the industry

Which is why threat intelligence and threat sharing are important as this area of security practice matures.  The absence of attackers on AI risk surfaces is a gift, but we should build connective tissue across the industry that allows us to watch them ramp up in AI-native attacks so we can dial our controls correctly and as quickly as possible.

controls.title: An Establishment Plot against Reform?
controls.full_text:
When parties get into trouble, they must
face the truth, accept what has come out
and deal with it.
Saying it is an establishment plot just
makes them look silly and a bit shifty.
It is quite the wrong response from
Reform following the undercover
reporting
of a number of councilors and members of
Reform expressing vile racist views.
This is really dangerous and I'm not
unsympathetic to Reform. I hold Nigel
Farage in very high regard and I know he
is not and never has been a racist, that
he has always been very careful to
ensure that his party avoids racism.
He's very conscious of the risk if you
believe in tough immigration policies
that you can be accused of being a
racist and therefore he has never been
in that category at all.
And this is something I value as well
because I too believe in tough
immigration policies, but I believe in
equality between the races in this
country.
So I admire what he has done and how he
has made immigration such an important
topic of public debate
because it's one the British people are
deeply concerned about and politicians
shied away from for many years because
they were worried about the racist
charge.
That makes it all the more important
that he deals with this problem
effectively and doesn't just say it's
bad people trying to stitch him up
because that won't wash.
Mass migration has made a big difference
to this country and it never had a
popular mandate. We know that
it was thought that 2 million people
would apply for settled status from the
European Union and that turned out to be
about 6 million. Almost three times as
many.
Mass waves of immigration coming from
continental Europe whilst we were in the
EU
and then similar numbers continuing to
come from the rest of the world after we
had left. This was a terrible failure of
public policy, but it was also a failure
to discuss the issue because post the
1968 Rivers of Blood speech by Enoch
Powell, and yes, I know he never said
Rivers of Blood, politicians have been
very wary of discussing immigration lest
they be called racist.
Nigel managed to change that, and part
of how he changed it was by being so
obviously not a racist himself.
This makes what members of his party has
done so particularly damaging
because those who are in favor of
uncontrolled migration, and there are
many on the left who still are,
will use this charge of racism not just
against reform, but against anybody who
speaks up in favor of controlling
immigration.
Now,
undercover television things have taken
place over many years. They've affected
all political parties. The Conservatives
have been caught out. Conservative MPs
have been tripped up by Labour MPs have
been tripped up by it. I can't remember
about Lib Dem MPs, but probably they
have too.
It's one of those things that is in a
way underhand,
but perhaps has to be done because if
people are behaving badly privately and
saying different things in public, how
else to expose them? And this is one of
the more sinister aspects of the ITV
report in that it showed people standing
for election saying, "Well, we better
not say this now, but once we're in
power."
And that makes voters uneasy and
nervous. We want politicians who say the
same thing in public and in private, and
what was being said was very unpleasant
well beyond the bounds of banter, or
normal political debate, or an
expression of a view that is widely held
in my view. I think the British people
are kindly and gentle and not racist and
do not want to see mass deportations of
people
who are legitimately here. And they
certainly don't like vile language being
used in respect
of their fellow British citizens. They
may regret that so much migration has
taken place, but they don't want to
penalize individuals who have themselves
done nothing wrong.
That's not to say that they aren't in
favor of deporting people who came
illegally. And again, when people make
the awful statements that have been
made, it elides illegal and legal
migration and makes it harder to make
the case for deporting illegals because
it sounds as if you want to get rid of
everybody. And people like me don't. We
want people who came illegally to be
removed, to have a proper process to
deal with that, to have a system of
deterrence that stops them coming in.
We want it to be harder for people to
come in legally because the numbers have
to be reduced. But what we don't want is
to have everybody who has come to this
country in the last 20 years, who has
got British citizenship, sitting at home
worrying that the knock on the door may
be from some strange squad
that is going to chuck them out of this
country.
It may have been a mistake to allow such
large numbers to come in, but we have a
duty to behave reasonably to them now
they are here in a fundamentally English
way.
So, I think the
undercover reporting is very damaging.
I think it's damaging to reform. It's
damaging to the debate on immigration.
But the response to it is going to be
absolutely crucial.
Conservatives like me have to carry on
talking about immigration in a moderate
and sensible way.
I think we need no further migration
into this country
for 5 years, perhaps 10 years, so that
we can allow the country to settle down
and that the people who are here to
integrate, to understand and learn our
culture and our language, and to join in
the great enterprise of our country.
I don't want on the other hand mass
expulsions of people who are
legitimately here.
I want a carefully targeted program to
remove those who are illegally here,
starting with people who have come here
illegally and committed crimes. We
should be getting rid of whatever it is
the 10, 12,000 people in our prisons who
are here and ought to be deported. That
would be a very good start. We should
remove people who come in
the day they arrive. We should have
clearly tough immigration policies.
But we shouldn't have racist policies.
What Reform now has to do is to chuck
out people who say this sort of thing,
check very carefully the social media of
its candidates
and of its um existing counselors.
And it has to have a system of
self-reporting.
That if you are a member of Reform, you
work for Reform and somebody says
something like this, you have to take it
up with higher authorities.
They will need to have a due diligence
process internally
that means that people don't say these
sorts of things and then get on in
Reform.
Because some of them were said with
party officials present who ought to
have been reporting them.
It just won't wash saying it's an
establishment stitch-up. It's not a good
enough answer.
I accept that the mainstream media is
quite lefty, but it's done this sort of
thing to Labour politicians.
It is what the media does. It's what a
free press does.
And we should always back a free press.
I'm afraid particularly when it
embarrasses politicians. The key for
reform will be in the response.
Because the British people aren't
racist, and they will never vote for a
racist party. And therefore, there must
be no apology for this conduct. But,
there must be an effort to root it out.
As always, thank you very much for
watching.

controls.title: Against "solving alignment" and "solving interpretability" as the major frame for AI safety and security
controls.full_text:
[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!QZVB!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fdb15dbce-60dc-4592-b7ee-be1b50fd6731_750x572.png]]

J. M. W. Turner’s Snow Storm: Steam-Boat off a Harbour’s Mouth (1842)

Civilization literally rests on our ability to approximately forecast and approximately control the edge-of-chaos natural, technological, and social systems from which we extract our livings; the laptop I'm typing this on was summoned from climate and bio systems we don't understand, and from global supply chains no one individual understands (and which could crash tomorrow for all we know), and is connected to an Internet no one understands.

AI systems will soon be such civilizational complex systems, with just as murky epistemics. Again, we'll never fully understand them. We'll understand them less as they progress.

This is what I think, which means I disagree with the median framing of AI safety research in policy circles, the labs, on podcasts, and on the news, which seems to say our problem is to interpret models' internals to make sure they're aligned.

Eventually -- supposedly! -- we'll understand models with many nines of precision, and read out guarantees that the models won't, say, purposely sabotage an air traffic control system, which will make them safe to deploy.

But we've been doing interpretability for at least 14 years, and it still hasn't produced anything like the reliable, scalable understanding required by that vision. As far as I can tell the problem is getting worse.

Interpretability as a field seems to be in a state of stasis at best -- and more likely fighting a rearguard action -- as capabilities advance like a rocket ship.

Contrast the feeling you get looking at a t-SNE plot of latent features in a safety paper, knowing the researchers might have tweaked hyperparameters to tell a clean just-so story, knowing it’s (usually) on a small-ish model, with the relative epistemic solidity of capabilities-progress news that a model has solved a verifiable Millennium Prize problem.

Feel the epistemic hollowness of the former and recognize how common that feeling is in literature making claims about deep learning internals.

I'm not against interpretability research at all as a data exploration approach and a way to back out stylized theories from models; I think just as we have wrong-but-useful theories of the economy that build intuition and provide a vocabulary for policy discussion, we should have the same for models; but the point is to abandon the conceit that they'll lead to formal proofs and formal control guarantees; there is no evidence for this.

This is fine, though! The goal has to be to build a civilization capable of safely leveraging and living with layered multi-agent systems that we'll never be able to make provable formal claims about.

AI safety, then, needs to become less blindered by computer science and more expansive; drawing from the interdisciplinary approach we take to safety in other parts of the industrial economy like air travel safety and car safety, and from the approach we take to disaster planning in areas like hurricanes, nuclear safety, pandemics, and financial crises.

In all of these cases we assume our models of the world are incomplete. We forecast imperfectly, monitor what actually happens, limit how much power we grant double-edged systems when our confidence is low, build layers of redundant protection, and plan for the protections to fail anyway.  I think this is much closer to what AI safety is actually going to look like.

For AI agent security and safety, my mental model is aligned with the plot below, which I keep iteratively refining.  Here the problem doesn’t reduce to ‘solving alignment’ or interpreting model latent states; it treats these as a single layer among many.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!c6Y2!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Ffe3b910a-b8a9-4477-9c60-9021607a8fab_1219x1290.jpeg]]

Analogously, in air travel, we assume the physical plane contains stochastic risk; our problem doesn’t reduce to “making planes safe”, it’s multilayered and contains feedbacks.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!C8WM!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Ff492ce47-5b98-4c6c-bff0-815b3e45d9bb_1172x1214.png]]

If history any guide — and I think it should be — we’ll never not be in a messy, layered control situation vis-a-vis making AI safe.  And that’s ok, and good, because it means we have a large historical reference class from which to draw experience around securing civilizational systems that are miraculously, and ferociously double-edged.

controls.title: AI #190: Scion of the Times
controls.full_text:
The amount of code being written at Anthropic continues to rise exponentially. It is being managed by Scion, their internal replacement for GitHub that is better suited to the scale and style of the operation, which they created with a small team in five months.

This week also saw the release of two supposed frontier model models.

Google has finally given us Gemini 4 Argon, along with a robust safety report. We do not yet know if Argon lives up to its benchmarks or internal hype. I plan to write up the safety report next week, time permitting. If and only if it is good enough or discussed enough we will also have a full report on capabilities.

Meta gave us Muse Wonder, which like Argon has some excellent benchmarks, although they were presented in a way that looked rather sus. There are some reports that it is very good, but again it is too early to know. I will issue a full report if and only if Muse Wonder has capabilities or discussion that seem worthy.

To help me decide and to let people have fun, I have markets on whether I will issue the reports on Argon and Wonder, respectfully.

OpenAI caught an employee planting a bug. How many more spies are out there?

A group used ChatGPT to create a full-chain exploit of Chrome and claimed a $250,000 bounty. Luckily for us it was the good guys this time.

Like most weeks, I covered a lot more. It was only a little over a week ago that OpenAI dumped solutions to hundreds of math problems. Then came news that OpenAI fired three safety researchers, without providing us a good explanation. Once again we went over the fact that arguments about AI consciousness remain highly motivated and at best overconfident. Finally, I emphasized that the safety culture at the labs is broken, which is one of the most important facts about the world.

Today I am flying out to another conference at Lighthaven. I probably posted this from the airport and it won’t include any events from last night, tomorrow’s post will be the monthly and Monday may be from the non-AI queue. This coming week will then be another case of me scrambling to catch up, especially with the model reviews still potentially looming.

Table of Contents

Language Models Offer Mundane Utility. Prompting is easy now.

Language Models Don’t Offer Mundane Utility. Writing still needs work.

Huh, Upgrades. Muse Wonder and Gemini 4 Argon.

On Your Marks. Are you sure the models got that question wrong?

Choose Your Fighter. Theo is a fan of Haiku 5.5.

Get My Agent On The Line. Agent retention rates are okay but not great.

Deepfaketown and Botpocalypse Soon. Literary world keeps getting exposed.

Cyber Lack of Security. A full-chain exploit of Chrome found in six days.

Spy Versus Spy. OpenAI employee caught planting a physical bug.

The Internet of AI Things. AIs might soon haunt various devices.

A Young Lady’s Illustrated Primer. AI is changing motherhood.

They Took Our Jobs. Epic Games to have an epic lack of human-written code.

Introducing. Microsoft-Decision-1 is based on… Qwen 3.5-9B? Really?

In Other AI News. The State of AI report isn’t what it used to be.

Massive Fraudulent Distillation. The fight continues.

Show Me the Money. Anthropic Q3 revenue of $16.8b. Nvidia to buy Reflection.

Quiet Speculations. There is accounting for taste, given enough data.

Quickly, There’s No Time. Timelines to RSI keep shrinking, moving into [AI] 2027.

The Quest for Sane Regulations. UK AISI regains access, CAISSI to White House.

Chip City. GPUs can be cheaper to buy then to rent by a large margin.

The Week in Audio. Soares, Lovely, Patel, Wang.

People Just Say Things.

The Virtue of Silence. [CENSORED].

Rhetorical Innovation. The four classes of AI user expertise levels.

[Artificial Intelligence]. We have met the enemy, and he is everywhere.

Aligning a Smarter Than Human Intelligence is Difficult. AI as insider risk.

Backdoor Man. Backdoors, and other things, are easy to insert and hard to remove.

Cooperative Alignment. Decision theory gives us some arguments for hope.

People Are Worried About AI Killing Everyone. The AI will be smarter than you.

Other People Are Not As Worried About AI Killing Everyone. They don’t know.

The Lighter Side. You know what you did.

Language Models Offer Mundane Utility

Prompting is easy now. As Boris Cherny says, tell the AI what you want to do, how to verify that it did it, and how much effort to spend, and you’re good. I’d add ‘and anything it needs to know.’ Presumably that was implied. Boris prompts on Slack, which means Claude already has a lot of context, enabling shorter prompts.

Do you trust Grok to go use your credit card without pausing for approval?

Elon Musk: To buy stuff, you can just take a picture of your credit card, drop it in the chat and Grok @Bot will scour the Internet for the best deal on the item you want and order it.

[Community note: No that’s not how you upload your CC information.]

The correct maximally allowed error rate on such actions is not zero. It also is not high, and if you are using this blind you likely will have no idea if it is getting the best price or the best item. Then again, did you know before?

How easy is prompting? Pliny shuffled this off to Opus 5.5 with a $200 subscription:

"can you wraite a promtp for a cron job that can run every day thajt will try to find solutions to unsolved ciphers or transltions or math problems or theormes or things of that nature!! every day a new attempt as hard as possible all day without giving ujp and with maximum ceraitvityy, resourcesleflses, andpersticense! dont worry about token spend! and dont forget a bit all caps lots of emojis celebration to notify the uers if we get any intersting or sucsfful confirmd reulsts!!"​

…

day 1, the legion picked its own target: J.-F. Bouchaudy's cipher-machine challenges. these are simulations of real vintage machines (Hebern rotor machines, the Kryha, Lorenz, SIGABA), with problems that had been sitting on his solver tables with no solver for months or years.

on the morning of day 2, i was half asleep when my laptop suddenly says, in a robot voice:
"Breakthrough. The Daily Oracle has a confirmed solution."

️️

i was startled.

then the ALL CAPS emoji flood hits my screen. Hebern 5-rotor Problem 8  then Kryha v2 Problem 5 

i emailed the author, Jean-François Bouchaudy, a French cryptography enthusiast who builds these machine simulators and challenges as a labor of love (he told me he started out programming on punch cards 凉). he checked both solutions and put my name on his solver tables as the first and only solver 﫡

This is the correct version of ‘do a breakthrough, make no mistakes.’ It’s that easy.

A thought experiment from Terence Tao:

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!J1ZC!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F9d51d9ba-5035-4f9e-bc9b-e44cf79c6762_1080x806.jpeg]]

It seems ethical, in a sane world, to allow volunteers to participate in such trials. If the cocktail passes a Phase 3 trial, then we should conclude that it works. No, I absolutely would not, if I had cancer, demand that there was a human who ‘understood how it works,’ and if the FDA required that I would yell about it a lot. Yes, of course you would also want to model tail risks that might not be showing up and take those risks into account, so I wouldn’t use this lightly, but if the cancer is lethal and otherwise untreatable then why not?

Obviously you would also have to worry about some form of active misalignment, and that this was part of some sort of takeover or similar attempt, at that point, but that is a very different concern than the ones Tao is presumably considering.

Tao instead has the next point be ‘the AI hacked the FDA and the drug both does not work and kills people’ but even if the AI is being malicious for the lulz no one going to do this by hacking the FDA, in the sense that the Phase 3 trial is a physical thing with many artifacts in the world, that is then examined by humans? So we would just notice. And if we didn’t, we’d notice pretty quickly after that. The only real risk is long-latency-only harm, which is already true today and has limited downside if you are treating otherwise deadly cancers.

Talk and write to people whose expertise lies elsewhere:

Dean W. Ball (OpenAI): By the way, in my experience contractors of all sorts have adopted AI for text-based communications and it has substantially improved coordination on home renovation projects

Language Models Don’t Offer Mundane Utility

Remember that, no matter how great Opus 5.5 is (and it’s pretty great), how many contributions you make or lines of code you write is not a good measure of productivity.

Ado (Anthropic): The weekend after Opus 5.5 launched I had my most productive coding day of the year (so far).

I do not blame OpenAI on this one:

unusual_whales: BREAKING: Iranian operatives used OpenAI models and fake personas to help plant news articles critical of the US war against Iran in multiple US media outlets, OpenAI has said.

Yes, OpenAI, Anthropic and other labs should try to prevent this, but you can only do so much. It is on the media outlets to be robust to this sort of play. You should not be able to ‘plant news articles’ by virtue of the ability to write AI slop and generate fake personas.

It would be a lot easier to spot and prevent such frauds, and also other types, if we did not have a bunch of ‘disparate impact’ rules around how we can spot and prevent fraud. Some regressions are de facto illegal. Those rules do not magically stop applying if you involve an LLM. LLMs are in large part regression and correlation machines. We will have to make a choice.

Either we allow LLM intermediation to render approximations of such calculations legal at Google-level scale, or we don’t. If we don’t, and we start auditing to make sure that banned correlations did not creep in, we are going to have a bad time.

Vauhini Vara: Yet Wakatama forcefully rejected the notion that an AI detector could, or should, be used to gauge AI involvement. “My stance, as the person who leads the prize, is that if there is such an accusation, I want proof that does not come from a machine.”

It is remarkable how much the literature world is determined not to believe in Pangram, often for the dumbest of reasons (aka water and power).

The burden of proof needs to go somewhere. If ‘an accusation’ of any kind shifts it onto the author, whether or not it is backed by evidence, that’s not great. A much better rule would be that AI detectors put the burden on the author to show they wrote it, whereas without the detectors you need other very strong evidence that the author did not write it.

Vauhini Vara: Wakatama remarked on details in Kundizeza’s story that strike her as so typically Zimbabwean that a Zimbabwean must have written them: the shame of moving from a nice suburb to a less privileged township; how the mother’s initial forbearance with the father gives way to taking matters into her own hands. Wakatama also perceives multiple layers of meaning. She doesn’t think AI models are capable of that kind of cultural or literary nuance.

But then, she acknowledged that she doesn’t use AI or AI detectors. “My first response when somebody asks me to use AI is that I think about water and energy,” she said—that is, AI companies’ excessive use of both. “That honestly overwhelms me, and I don’t want to.”

… I’ve covered AI for almost a decade, and have written fiction for even longer; in short, I’ve had plenty of exposure to both literature and chatbot output. I know from experience that, for example, AI models aren’t terrible at picking up on cultural details.

Those details do not sound like things that an AI would have any trouble finding. They sound, if anything, like cliches, and not ones unique to Africa or Zimbabwe.   Multiple layers of meaning are sometimes rich and intentional, but also you can pretty much always find them if you look hard enough. After $40,000 in compute from GPT-5.6 Sol, XBow claims the second $250,000 bounty for a full-chain exploit of Chrome. Unlike OpenAI, Google pays real bounties, and this still should have been ten times larger.

Oege de Moor: For the second time in Google Chrome’s history, Google awarded a $250,000 bounty for a full-chain exploit… to @XBOW . Here’s the full story:

At an all-hands at the start of 2026 in Malta, I set the team a crazy challenge. A full-chain exploit of Chrome by the annual Black Hat cybersecurity conference in August. I believed there were few better tests of whether @XBOW could move beyond web applications to desktop software, servers and devices.

Chrome is one of the most hardened pieces of software on the planet, used by more than half the world’s population.

A full-chain exploit lets an attacker take total control of a machine, where they can read every email, password and bank login the user types. You don’t need to download anything or click a phishing link. Visiting the wrong site is enough.

So @moyix , Andres Luksenberg, Baul Lee, and Willem Pinckaers took on the challenge along with a fifth teammate: OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol.

They built a chain they thought would win, but Google told us they already knew one of the bugs. We were already in Las Vegas for Black Hat and DEF CON, and the team didn’t want to go home without the win.

So Brendan and the agents built a new exploit in just 6 days. We submitted it to Google and waited.

The news came through that we’d done what should’ve been impossible. A full-chain bounty of $250,000, the first awarded under Google’s 2026 rules.

It took just 6 days and $40,000 of compute to construct an exploit that affects a billion users of Chrome on Windows. An intelligence-agency veteran told me his team used to spend 6 months on this kind of vulnerability.

My takeaway: the cost of finding truly critical vulnerabilities is collapsing, for attackers and defenders alike. Restricting powerful models is not the answer; GPT-5.6 Sol is already public.

But defenders have one advantage attackers never will: they can test their own code first. Assume your software is exploitable. Whoever is hunting your bugs has the same building blocks we did. This is cause for urgency but not panic.

… P.S. Restart Chrome whenever the Update button appears!

Yeah, okay, let’s all restart Chrome whenever the Update button appears.

Yes, defenders get to test their code first. But here we have essentially the most widely used, most vital software on the planet that needs to not be exploitable. XBOW exploited it, Google said they already knew about (but had not fixed) one of the bugs, and then XBOW turned around and broke Chrome again in six days.

That’s with GPT-5.6 Sol, which is now two generations behind. GPT-6.1 Sol is a lot better at this sort of thing, and Opus 5.5 is even better than Sol.

I’m sure XBOW’s engineers are somewhat cracked, but they’re not uniquely cracked. There are tons of people who could have done this. We are fortunate the one that did it was wearing a white hat this time.

The world seems like it is playing with fire. We have been saved, so far, almost entirely by the fact that People Don’t Do Things. That won’t hold forever.
